findings.claim: CLAUDE.md says the UI receives view models from `src/ui/types.ts`, but the game passes the UI the sim's own view types (`RaceView`, `CarView` from src/sim/types.ts). `HudState` in ui/types.ts is built inside race-ui.ts, not by the game loop, so the ui/types.ts header is also wrong. A feature night adding a HUD field would go looking for a game-side builder that doesn't exist.
findings.evidence: CLAUDE.md (How the game fits together): "the UI receives view models (`src/ui/types.ts`), never the sim." src/ui/types.ts:1 "// View models the UI renders. Built by the game loop from sim views; the UI never reads the sim." In fact src/game.ts:207 `ui.sync(view, r.curr);` with `const view = raceView(r.world)` (:202), and src/ui/race-ui.ts:44 `sync(view: RaceView, cars: readonly CarView[]): void;`, where RaceView/CarView come from '../sim/types.ts' (race-ui.ts:5). HudState is created and kept by race-ui itself: race-ui.ts:73 `let state: HudState | null = null;`. game.ts never imports src/ui/types.ts. Its only importers are hud.ts:11, race-ui.ts:14, start-screen.ts:13, track-card.ts:7 and start.stage.ts:7.
findings.suggestedFix: Docs only. CLAUDE.md: "…the UI receives the sim's view types (`RaceView`, `CarView` from `src/sim/types.ts`), never the World; race-ui builds its own view models (`src/ui/types.ts`) from them." src/ui/types.ts:1: "View models the UI renders, built by race-ui.ts (and the game, for track cards) from sim views; the UI never reads the World."

findings.claim: `carOnTrack` in the stage fixtures is exported, but only stage.ts itself uses it. No stage, test or harness file imports it.
findings.evidence: src/ui/stages/stage.ts:76 `export function carOnTrack(centre: readonly [number, number][], at: number): CarView {`. Its only use is stage.ts:128 `o.at.map((a) => carOnTrack(centre, a)),`. A repo-wide grep (excluding node_modules) for `carOnTrack` finds only these two lines.
findings.suggestedFix: Drop the `export` keyword on carOnTrack (stage.ts:76). Nothing else changes, and stages are never shipped.
